title: Axolotl wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='26' ry='20' fill='#ff9ec9'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='80' rx='15' ry='11' fill='#ffd3e8'/>

  <path d='M74 74 Q90 70 88 84 Q86 92 78 88' fill='#ff8fc0' stroke='#ffb8d8' stroke-width='2'/>

  <path d='M27 68 Q14 70 16 80' fill='none' stroke='#ff9ec9' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- right arm -->
  <path d='M73 68 Q86 70 84 80' fill='none' stroke='#ff9ec9' stroke-width='6' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- gills left -->
  <path d='M28 40 Q14 30 10 42' fill='none' stroke='#ff7ab8' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M28 48 Q12 48 12 58' fill='none' stroke='#ff7ab8' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M30 56 Q18 62 22 70' fill='none' stroke='#ff7ab8' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- gills right -->
  <path d='M72 40 Q86 30 90 42' fill='none' stroke='#ff7ab8' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M72 48 Q88 48 88 58' fill='none' stroke='#ff7ab8' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 56 Q82 62 78 70' fill='none' stroke='#ff7ab8' stroke-width='5' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <rect x='30' y='38' width='17' height='12' rx='5' fill='#3a4a7a' stroke='#8fa8e0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <rect x='53' y='38' width='17' height='12' rx='5' fill='#3a4a7a' stroke='#8fa8e0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- sunglasses bridge -->
  <path d='M47 43 Q50 41 53 43' fill='none' stroke='#8fa8e0' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- sunglasses arms -->
  <path d='M30 42 L24 41' stroke='#8fa8e0' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M70 42 L76 41' stroke='#8fa8e0' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- glasses shine -->
  <rect x='33' y='41' width='4' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#c7d6ff'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M42 58 Q50 64 58 58' fill='none' stroke='#e8578f' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='55' r='3' fill='#ff6fae' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='55' r='3' fill='#ff6fae' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
